commits.indexing_implications: JOB_DEP_FAILED is an appended enum state, not a collection position. PkgId/config keys, dependency vectors, package names, and extension maps are graph identifiers or relationships. n_failed, n_dep_failed, ndeps, n_already_precomp, and length(...) are counts. pid and had_pid are process metadata. In failed_dependency and report_precompile_results!, tuple destructuring and first(k) preserve package/config data; config[0] is consistent with Joolia's existing zero-origin adaptation. Existing local conversions in base/precompilation.jl, including displaysize tuple accesses, match captures, split fields, config access, and only(configs)[0], remain intact. The producer-to-consumer path is dependency graph -> PrecompileJob status/error root -> report output; no new public position conversion is needed.
commits.adaptations: None. The changed integers are enum tags, graph identifiers, sentinels, process metadata, booleans, or counts rather than collection positions. The merged base/precompilation.jl preserves Joolia's existing origin conversions. No files were changed because another SHA triggers the protected-file stop condition.
